maria-peopleops: Heads-up — week-zero logistics for the new cohort arriving Mon 2026-06-02. Need I-9 drop-in schedule, shuttle plan, orientation room booking, and lunch headcount. Who can own which piece? :wave:

sachin-it: I can own shuttle + badge pickup. Can we confirm shuttle capacity?

chelsie-people-ops: I'll own I-9 scheduling and BG intake. I'll coordinate time slots with ADP. Prefer 9–11am slots.

dan-ops: Conf C (2nd fl) reserved 8:30–12:30. AV + projector confirmed.

maria-peopleops: Awesome. @sachin-it can you post shuttle pickup times by EOD? @chelsie please add a sign-up link for I-9 slots.

sachin-it: Sure — shuttle runs 8:00 / 8:20 / 8:40 from Midtown lot. Capacity 12 each. I'll post a SignUp later.

chelsie-people-ops: Draft sign-up and doc checklist:
```
I-9 drop-in slots (bring ONE original ID):
- 9:00
- 9:30
- 10:00
- 10:30
- 11:00
BG intake: consent form + email confirmation from background vendor
```
I'll add to the invite.

eli-newhire: Quick q — do I need to bring passport if I have driver's license + social? I'm remote but flying in.

chelsie-people-ops: If you're a US citizen, driver's license + SSN works. If not, bring passport. We'll confirm in the sign-up form too.

maria-peopleops: Lunch options — 18 people. Any dietary restrictions? Reply with allergies. Also we have $12/person budget. :sandwich:

frank-peopleops: I'll collate dietary replies and order from SaladBox + hot trays.

reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled: post shuttle times (sachin-it) at 18:00 today.

maria-peopleops: Thanks team — check back here after posting links. :thumbsup:
